headline: Gold at lowest since September 2025 after hawkish Fed minutes
summary: Minutes of the Fed's October meeting showed concern over sticky inflation and a governor floated a 50 bp rise; markets now price about a 90% chance of a December hike, pushing gold to a 14-month low and silver below $45.

headline: Promoter Indo Borax pledges its entire 64% stake
summary: Indo Borax pledged all 2.38 crore Kronox shares it holds as added security for a roughly ₹225 crore loan taken to buy the stake; it says ownership and control are unchanged.
